reviewer: dip_phase1_verify; independent of feature, structure and runner authors except the explicitly assigned boundary correction
scope: Verification covers the experimental implementation and isolated runner as they existed before the user requested ordinary pipeline/train/live/pruning integration. This is not approval of that pending integration or a claim of predictive value.

numerical_reconstruction.manual_method: Raw JSON floats, scalar list slices, statistics.mean/stdev; no production rolling/formula helpers in expected values.
numerical_reconstruction.current_future_hlcv_and_future_open_muta: all 21 current features unchanged on seven raw MRCY dates
numerical_reconstruction.current_open_mutation: all 13 prior-only columns unchanged on seven dates

low validity recovers exactly when missing bar exits

numerical_reconstruction.protocol_schema: 21 unique names, four ordered families and four flags match exactly

tests.note: Final runner chronology/snapshot/warning guards are included. Full-suite dip target reused the immediately preceding successful boundary-patch test.

resolved_defects.finding: Inclusive ratio thresholds could reject mathematically exact decimal-price boundaries due to binary rounding.
resolved_defects.example: 102/100 - 1 produces 0.020000000000000018 and incorrectly rejected exact 2% near-low; 3.43/3.5 - 1 produces -0.019999999999999907 and incorrectly rejected exact 2% decline.
resolved_defects.fix: Named dimensionless 1e-12 comparison tolerance for inclusive 2% decline, 0..2% low distance, 0..25% recovery and >=50% closing location only. Strict support/pressure/trend comparisons remain strict.
resolved_defects.approval: Parent explicitly assigned this narrow fix after discovery; original author independently reviewing patch.
resolved_defects.validation: Ten added exact-versus-1e-8-outside cases; all 40 cases pass.

checks: All 21 names and four families match frozen protocol exactly; four flags match.
Prior low uses exactly 252 completed canonical bars, newest tie gets age one; invalid bars retained as NaN.
Pre-shock sigma uses twenty returns ending t-3; neither shock return enters denominator.
Support uses t-21 through t-2; yesterday cannot move its own support level.
No current/future HLCV or current volume is read by current decision fields. Eight Open-known fields are explicitly classified.
Unknown setup inputs remain NaN; validity indicators are intentionally 0/1.
Scalar helper and historical builder share computation and reject invalid/future dates.
Complete calendar and common adjustment basis are explicit caller contracts, not silently inferred.

cluster_repair_review.independent_data_agent_results: 1,981 real tickers, manual leave-self-out error <=2.0816681711721685e-17; current-close/current-cluster mutation invariant; live parity.
checks: Prior membership shifts within each ticker before aligning calendar.
Current peer gaps exclude self and nonfinite values; missing prior label and no peers produce NaN.
Live fill clears stale prior gap when current peers unavailable.
Historical/live public helpers preserve indexes and use the same aggregation.
Aligns by immutable date/ticker, exact schemas, rejects holdout/SPY, keeps candidate NaNs and MRCY.
252 prior sessions only; explicit chronology guard again at model fit.
Positive projection keeps label/metadata/unselected candidates out of inputs; actual Rank custom objective retained.
Compact columns chosen only from same-window training gain.
Inner-only results select algorithm; outer phases require run-bound frozen selection. Inner parquet reads exclude later labels.
All nine variants share identical rows and current-configuration baseline; SVM source inputs frozen at 132.
OOF Fit scores are strictly prior-trained, joined by row digest; uncovered early rows are omitted/reported rather than filled in sample.
Atomic finite numeric checkpoints bind source/input/dependency manifests, identity/order, column schema and chronology; checksum/context mismatches fail.
Research-only outputs, no ModelStore/save/pruning/production writes; processes and numerical thread counts bounded.

checked: No standalone mandatory buy gate introduced; continuous measurements and flags remain incremental experimental inputs.
No MRCY-specific exclusion, candidate-NaN row deletion, or test-period threshold tuning.
No current-close cluster membership used for an Open-known peer feature after repair.
No future values smuggled through flag validity, zero-filled unknown setup flags, or double shift of decision-aligned candidates.
No silent activation in persisted features, default FeatureService, live inference or saved model schema.
No duplicated live formula path, unbounded SVM process pool, in-sample SVM replacement or unversioned checkpoint reuse.

checks: Focused pure feature module and scalar adapter; economic constants and ordered schemas are explicit.
Metadata separated from numeric computation; existing candle/trend/volume helpers reused.
Structure aggregation is shared and vectorized by group rather than duplicated live logic.
Runner separates alignment, temporal slicing, metric calculation, selection and checkpoints.
Tests target causal mutation, unknown history, precise thresholds, row identity, cache corruption and chronology.
No unnecessary refactor of existing model/pipeline production behavior; explicit narrow cluster timing repair applies equally to baseline and candidates.
code_quality_review.diagnostics: No LSP was available; final Bazel import/type/runtime tests and git diff --check are the applicable verification.

limitations: Implementation verification does not establish trading efficacy; Phase2 model comparisons are still required.
Raw reconstruction checks MRCY across all its model-eligible dates and representative causal mutations; not every ticker/source corporate action was independently certified.
Historical current-universe/static-sector/source-adjustment limitations remain as frozen in protocol.
Complete exchange-calendar alignment is enforced by panel construction, not inferable from the low-level OHLCV helper.
Full-data model training and multiprocessing SVM runtime were not performed by this verifier; fake-model unit tests validate projection/checkpoint mechanics.
Official-open feature benchmark is not guaranteed executable after observing that same opening price.
The unrelated existing Jev database change remains dirty and was not altered; it is outside the 4,007-file frozen source manifest.
remaining_blockers: Ordinary pipeline/train/live/catalog/pruning integration is newly authorized and pending separate implementation and verification.
